quests.instruction: The letters oi and oy make the same sound, /oy/. Which word has it?
quests.hint: Say oy like the sound you make when you hurt your toe: oy!
quests.explanation: “Coin” has oi, which makes /oy/. “Corn” has /or/ and “cone” has long o.

quests.instruction: Which word ends with the /oy/ sound spelled oy?
quests.hint: Look at the last two letters.
quests.explanation: “Toy” ends with oy. “Toe” and “too” end with different vowel sounds.
quests.funFact: At the end of a word, /oy/ is nearly always spelled oy, as in boy, joy and enjoy.

quests.instruction: Which letters complete the word? b__ — a young male child.
quests.hint: The word ends with the /oy/ sound.
quests.explanation: “Boy” ends with oy.

quests.instruction: Which word spells the /oy/ sound with oi in the middle?
quests.hint: Check the middle of each word.
quests.explanation: “Boil” has oi in the middle. “Boy” has oy at the end and “bell” has short e.
quests.funFact: Oil, boil, coin and join use oi inside a word, while boy, toy and joy use oy at the end.

quests.instruction: Which spelling is correct? You use ___ to cook food in a pan.
quests.hint: Remember that oi goes before a consonant.
quests.explanation: “Oil” is spelled with oi before l.

quests.instruction: Which word has the long o sound spelled o_e, not oi or oy?
quests.hint: Check the end of each word for a silent e.
quests.explanation: “Bone” uses the o_e pattern for long o. “Boil” and “boy” have the /oy/ sound.

quests.instruction: Which word has the /ow/ sound spelled ou?
quests.hint: Say ow like you just got a pinch: ow!
quests.explanation: “Cloud” has ou, which makes the /ow/ sound.
quests.funFact: Cloud, house, mouse, round and sound all have ou saying /ow/.

quests.instruction: Which letters complete the word? m__se — a small furry animal that squeaks.
quests.hint: Say the word. Which vowel team makes the /ow/ sound?
quests.explanation: “Mouse” has ou for the /ow/ sound.

quests.instruction: Which word has /ow/ in the middle and ends with /nd/?
quests.hint: Check the vowel and the ending.
quests.explanation: “Round” is /r/ /ow/ /n/ /d/. “Road” has long o and “rend” has short e.

quests.instruction: Which word has the /ow/ sound spelled ow, like “cow”?
quests.hint: Look for ow in the middle or at the end.
quests.explanation: “Brown” has ow with the /ow/ sound.

quests.instruction: Which letters complete the word? d__n — the opposite of up.
quests.hint: Say the word. Which team makes /ow/ here?
quests.explanation: “Down” uses ow for /ow/. “Doun” is not a word.

quests.instruction: Which word has the /ow/ sound but is NOT spelled ou?
quests.hint: Look for the word with ow.
quests.explanation: “Town” has ow. “House” and “cloud” both have ou.
quests.funFact: Both ou and ow can spell /ow/. Words that end with this sound usually use ow.

quests.instruction: The letters ow can say /ow/ as in cow, or long o as in snow. Which word has the /ow/ sound of “cow”?
quests.hint: Say each word and listen for ow like in a sudden pinch.
quests.explanation: “Now” has the /ow/ sound. In “blow” and “show” ow says long o.

quests.instruction: Which word has the long o sound spelled ow?
quests.hint: Find the word where ow says its own name.
quests.explanation: “Bowl” has long o. “Brown” and “clown” have /ow/.
quests.funFact: Snow, bowl and grow have long o spelled ow, but cow and now have the /ow/ sound.

quests.instruction: Which word has the same vowel sound as “flower”?
quests.hint: Say flower slowly. What sound do you hear at the start?
quests.explanation: “Flower” and “owl” both have /ow/. “Bowl” and “blow” have long o.

quests.instruction: Which word has the /aw/ sound spelled aw?
quests.hint: Say aw like you do when you see a cute puppy.
quests.explanation: “Paw” has aw. “Pat” has short a and “pay” has long a.
quests.funFact: Paw, saw and draw all end with aw. Aw is also common before n or l, as in lawn and crawl.

quests.instruction: Which word has the /aw/ sound spelled au?
quests.hint: Look for the letters a and u side by side.
quests.explanation: “Sauce” has au for the /aw/ sound.

quests.instruction: Which letters complete the word? dr__ — you do this with a pencil.
quests.hint: The word ends with /aw/. Which spelling goes at the end?
quests.explanation: “Draw” ends with aw.
quests.funFact: Au usually comes in the middle of a word and aw usually comes at the end.

quests.instruction: Which word has the long oo sound, like “moon”?
quests.hint: Say moon slowly, then compare the vowel in each choice.
quests.explanation: “Food” has the long oo sound. “Foot” has the short oo sound and “fed” has short e.

quests.instruction: Which word has the short oo sound, like “book”?
quests.hint: The short oo is quick, like in good.
quests.explanation: “Cook” has the short oo sound. “Cool” has long oo and “cone” has long o.

quests.instruction: Which word has a different oo sound from the other two?
quests.hint: Say each word and listen for a short or a long oo.
quests.explanation: “Moon” and “food” have long oo. “Good” has short oo.
quests.funFact: The letters oo make two different sounds. You have to try both to see which makes a real word.

quests.instruction: Which letters spell the long oo sound at the end of “new”?
quests.hint: Say new slowly and look at the letters that come after n.
quests.explanation: “New” ends with ew, which makes the long oo sound.
quests.funFact: New, few, grew, flew and chew all end with ew.

quests.instruction: Which word has the ew spelling?
quests.hint: Look for e and w together.
quests.explanation: “Grew” has ew. “Green” has ee and “grow” has ow.

quests.instruction: Which word has the same vowel sound as “moon”?
quests.hint: Say moon and listen to the vowel.
quests.explanation: “Moon” and “flew” both have the long oo sound. “Flow” has long o and “flaw” has /aw/.

quests.instruction: Which word has a vowel sound that does not match the other two?
quests.hint: Say each word and listen to the vowel sound.
quests.explanation: “Boy” and “coin” have /oy/. “Cow” has /ow/.
quests.funFact: Cow, now, how and brown all use ow for the /ow/ sound.

quests.instruction: Which word has the /oy/ sound?
quests.hint: Look for the letters oi.
quests.explanation: “Noise” has oi for /oy/. “Nose” has long o and “north” has /or/.

quests.instruction: Which word starts with a blend and has the /aw/ sound?
quests.hint: You need two clues: two sounds at the start, and the aw vowel.
quests.explanation: “Crawl” starts with /k/ /r/ and has /aw/. “Clown” has /ow/ and “clap” has short a.

quests.instruction: Which word has the same vowel sound as “cloud”?
quests.hint: Say cloud slowly and listen to the vowel.
quests.explanation: “Cloud” and “down” both have /ow/. “Dawn” has /aw/ and “doom” has long oo.
quests.funFact: Cloud and down use different letters, ou and ow, for the same /ow/ sound.

quests.instruction: Which word has the same vowel sound as “saw”?
quests.hint: Say saw and listen to the vowel.
quests.explanation: “Saw” and “yawn” both have /aw/. “Yarn” has /ar/ and “yolk” has long o.

quests.instruction: Match the sounds: which pair shares the same vowel?
quests.hint: Say each pair out loud.
quests.explanation: “Boy” and “oil” both have /oy/. “Owl” and “out” have /ow/.
